question: What division of the eight octads is sought to be known fully?
premises: A division of eight octads is named
The aim is to know it fully
The knowing is described as endless
inference: The division of the eight octads is to be known fully and endlessly
uncertainties: anantathā may qualify the division or the manner of knowing
plain_english: I seek to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
